summary: News Corp filed an 8-K announcing disclosures made to the Australian Securities Exchange regarding its ongoing stock repurchase program. The program authorizes the repurchase of up to $1 billion in aggregate of Class A and Class B common stock. The filing includes daily transaction disclosures as required by ASX rules, attached as exhibits. No specific repurchase amounts, prices, or dates are stated in the excerpt. The company reaffirms its intent to repurchase shares from time to time, subject to market conditions and other factors. The filing is routine disclosure of an existing capital return program, not a new tender offer. What to watch: ongoing pace and pricing of repurchases, and any program completion updates in future filings.
